evidence.quote: we expect that a highly accommodative stance of monetary policy will remain appropriate for a considerable time after the economy strengthens.
we are buying $85 billion of longer-term securities per month through the end of the year.
it simply has not been growing fast enough recently to make significant progress in bringing down unemployment.
we expect inflation to remain low for the foreseeable future.
if that were allowed to occur, it would likely throw the economy back into recession.
If, in contrast, the Fed were to raise rates now, before the economic recovery is fully entrenched, house prices might resume declines
